purpose: Define Home executive pages by the findings and deterministic evidence they are allowed to render, not by empty slots.
rules: A page exists because deterministic evidence produces a finding, a refusal, or a deferred evidence request.
Each page must name the question it answers, the lead number it opens on, one governing table, findings with owner and because-clause, and drill links to rows.
Facts, money, counts, dates, owners, vendors, systems, and relationships are deterministic. Claude may interpret and caption; it may not calculate or invent.
Executive pages start from business model, segment economics, accountability, value, and exposure before naming individual vendors or tools.
Technical pages use expert technologist language and may name systems, platforms, ETL, reporting, and architecture once the page contract asks for that lens.
Published, refused, and deferred are the only terminal states. A missing page or missing section is a gate failure.
Every displayed count must name its denominator and be computed through the typed view or declared source table identified by the contract.
Current-state architecture and data-flow pages inherit admission gates. A refused gate renders the refusal payload instead of a clean diagram.

charts.reason: Shows over-service and under-service against declared revenue share faster than a table.
Shows magnitude contrast across application archetypes.
Shows renewal clustering and auto-renew exposure as decision windows.
Reuse the Tower value bridge instead of building a second chart.

pages.title: What this enterprise is
pages.question: How does the business create value, and which economics matter most?

lead_fact.statement: 40% of revenue runs on 10.8% of applications.

pages.findings_contract: Lead with segment economics and operating model. Do not open on a vendor unless the page question is explicitly commercial concentration.
required_findings: segments whose resource share differs materially from declared revenue share
zero-attribution segment gaps that require owner review

pages.title: What it runs on
pages.question: Which system blocks and archetypes support the operating model?

lead_fact.statement: Departmental clinical carries far more application cost than the clinical core.

pages.governing_table: application archetype x hosting x business segment crosstabs
pages.findings_contract: Use expert technologist language. Start conceptual, then logical, then physical system names.
required_findings: hosting model divergence across operating segments

pages.title: Where it is hosted
pages.question: Which hosting, resilience, capacity, and lifecycle facts constrain the estate?

lead_fact.statement: Hot disaster recovery is limited; backup-only platforms require explicit treatment.

pages.governing_table: platform inventory by hosting model, DR tier, capacity headroom, support end date
pages.findings_contract: Show platform constraints as technology facts, not as executive prose filler.

pages.title: How data moves
pages.question: How does data move from sources through integration, platforms, marts, analytics, and consumption?

lead_fact.statement: Regulated data and non-production-governed assets must be shown as architecture constraints.

pages.governing_table: data asset and integration register by source, target, governance state, reporting/ETL volume, and users
pages.findings_contract: Show sources, integration, warehouses/marts, consumption, and advanced analytics as separate blocks.
required_findings: report, ETL, script, and user volume concentrations

pages.title: What it buys
pages.question: Which vendors and contracts shape cost, risk, renewal leverage, and sourced value?

lead_fact.statement: Auto-renewal and exit economics define the commercial clock.

pages.governing_table: contract register by supplier, value, renewal, auto-renew, TFC, scope, and service lines
pages.findings_contract: Commercial concentration belongs here, not as the opening executive identity of the enterprise.

pages.title: What it costs and returns
pages.question: What performance, spend, value, and outcome signals should leadership act on?

lead_fact.statement: Ready value claims and finance-attested value must be separated from blocked or pending claims.

pages.governing_table: value claims by readiness, blocked reason, attestation state, and unblock action
pages.findings_contract: Use CFO language. Do not turn unverified opportunity into claimable value.
required_findings: blocked value with owner and next evidence

pages.title: What it is betting on
pages.question: Where is the enterprise trying to go, what bets are funded, and what value is at stake?

lead_fact.statement: Funded programs and expected value define the strategy agenda only when tied to stage gates and proof state.

pages.governing_table: program portfolio by priority, funded amount, expected value, stage gate, blocked reason, and proof state
pages.findings_contract: Make the strategy agenda business-led; do not fill the page if program evidence is thin.
required_findings: programs blocked by evidence or owner action

pages.title: What is exposed
pages.question: What needs executive attention now, and what evidence says so?

lead_fact.statement: Open controls, rated risks, unresolved evidence, and remediation cost define the attention agenda.

pages.governing_table: risk/control register by severity, control state, owner, remediation, and evidence gap
pages.findings_contract: Use red only for rated high severity in the source register; use amber for absence or unresolved evidence.
required_findings: evidence gaps that block a claim

pages.title: Who owns what
pages.question: Who has authority, where are accountabilities clear, and what do leaders say?

lead_fact.statement: Decision rights, budget authority, workforce roles, and interview excerpts define accountability.

pages.governing_table: organization and interview register by segment, function, owner, decision rights, role, theme, and excerpt
pages.findings_contract: Separate senior strategic themes from director-level process/tool detail.

pages.title: The record
pages.question: What source families, rows, columns, gaps, and provenance can be inspected?

lead_fact.statement: Citable evidence is the denominator for every page.

pages.governing_table: source file inventory by family, rows, columns, fill rate, constant columns, source hash, and citable state
pages.findings_contract: The record browser must be slice/dice before table browsing, with cell provenance from any figure to filtered rows.
required_findings: constant columns that are defaults rather than assessments
columns or families read but not claimable
